'''March 2000 Pittsburgh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Starbase One, Pittsburgh, PA on 5 March 2000. [[Eric Steinhauser]] won it. It is known from Eric Steinhauser's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d309">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-05-mara-s-obsession-pittsburgh-3-5-2000d309/ mara-s-obsession-pittsburgh-3-5-2000], DeckTech (Eric "Brutus_9" Steinhauser, 5 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-05-mara-s-obsession-pittsburgh-3-5-2000d309/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Starbase One, Pittsburgh, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Steinhauser]]
